why: No major reviewer or authority shows up for this search. Most results are single-brand product pages: Renogy appears three times, at $318.99 with no group size, and Vatrer and MillerTech show no price. Three pages couldn't be read at all, and two are broad listicles. One of those listicles claims testing it can't back up, and the other is built around Group 27. Only AnglerLeague answers the question, and only partly: it gives a dated price for one Group 24 Bluetooth pick under $300. A focused page comparing Group 24 Bluetooth batteries under $300 with current prices and a direct pick would stand out.
